findings.finding: Uniform symbol identities overstated as universal forces, field existence and varying-field species degeneracy.
findings.resolution: Retain corner identities with invertibility and leading-order domains; local axial reference-rate ray comparison only; divergence compatibility does not establish solutions; distinguish formal branch-label orbits from static finite eigenvalue doubling and exact field transformation table.

findings.finding: Signed weak rays and restricted stress comparators promoted to coupled dynamics, field no-go or physical species selection.
findings.resolution: State weak translation-invariant pair assumptions, existing-length condition for rate positivity and exact projector domain; retain exact clocked commutators and component signs; restore stationary hypotheses and omitted coframe stress terms; no universal field-solution conclusion.

findings.finding: Polynomial range proof uses false general product rule; normalized momentum classification and closed-static exclusions omit exceptions.
findings.resolution: Use noncancelling outward coefficient proof for the special product; classify only normalized polynomial momenta. Include uniform zero-source solution and nonconstant-field condition, net-site source interpretation and distinct-site homogeneous-torus pair domain.

findings.finding: Filled-energy evenness conflated with differentiability, approximate response with exact Hessian; scalar hop claimed to break every nonidentity exchange.
findings.resolution: Require differentiability for derivative statements, separate declared comparator from checkerboard-null exact Hessian and its source compatibility; correct full periodic negative eigenstate. All-axis exchange survives at zero offset; corner energy magnitudes are not automatically rest masses; staggered gap uses absolute mass.

findings.finding: Exclusion/compression treated as axiomatic dynamics; finite traces and line kernels generalized; staggered corner mixing and observable conservation test omitted.
findings.resolution: Supply composition and compression explicitly; preserve finite trace and counterexample scope; distinguish whole-generator from kinetic-only clocking, literal five-profile nullities from three-dimensional wall claims. Fixed-state density identity retained; antisymmetric opposite-coin scalar-momentum witness replaces ordered same-coin witness; projector noncommutation does not prove compressed-observable nonconservation.
